routes.comment: Vite fingerprints these filenames, so the content behind a given URL never changes and it can be cached indefinitely. The global no-store below is right for index.html — which must be refetched so a deploy takes effect — but applying it to the bundles re-downloaded the whole app on every page load.

globalHeaders.Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' data: https://fonts.gstatic.com;
